summary: 352 contrôles navigateur réussis sur Chromium réel : 322 dans le passage complet conservé et 30 dans le complément ciblé. Trois tenues V10 sélectionnées et observées dans six combats (ordinateur/mobile), deux nouveaux décors et trois accessoires vérifiés avec proportions et ancrages conservés pendant un déplacement, neuf fiches galerie inspectées, badge et note historique complète de Crymini visibles. Les trois groupes de liens officiels des costumes affichent leurs URL qualifiées. Formats ordinateur 1440×1000 et mobile émulé 390×844. Aucun débordement horizontal, asset manquant, 404, exception ou console.error observé. Les 167 empreintes runtime sont identiques entre les deux passages et à la finalisation.

visualReview.method: 43 main-run captures inspected through loaded contact sheets, including native desktop/mobile stage reopens; 8 final source-link/provenance captures opened directly at native size. Captures absent from reviewedLabels are retained as automated-run evidence without a manual-review claim.
observations: The three V10 costumes show complete silhouettes in selection and combat captures in both viewports. Their gallery images retain heads/horns, tails and feet within the visible image.
The nine new gallery illustrations are visible without observed stretching or a solid opaque cutout background. The three prop silhouettes and the three reserve character bases are complete.

Both backgrounds keep their native aspect ratios. The console/candelabrum and snowglobe remain at the documented source positions in the initial and post-movement images; numeric anchoring and shared-parallax checks in the preserved run also passed.

Crymini is explicitly labelled MODÈLE HISTORIQUE · 2017. The supplemental native captures show the entire note saying this concept predates the series and does not establish a current-season appearance.
Each of the three costume entries renders its three qualified official links, with legible text in both viewports; the supplemental browser measurements confirm their exact href values.
nonBlockingObservations: At 390×844 the closed native costume selects truncate long option labels. Adjacent descriptions identify the costume and episode; no control overlap was observed.
The contain-sized wide backgrounds leave a solid-color band above the artwork in the tall mobile arena, and side bands on desktop. This preserves the complete background framing.

Full-page screenshots show only their captured viewport. Long descriptions are read by scrolling; the eight supplemental images intentionally isolate the reference lists and the complete Crymini note.
limits: This visual review covers the listed capture pixels and observed states, not a physical mobile device, every camera boundary or all historical game content.
Still images do not certify animation timing. The separate recorded keyboard/touch samples establish that the same static costume source was retained during the sampled actions.
Reference link rendering was verified locally; the linked external pages were not opened during the supplement, and current remote availability is outside this browser check.
No exact canonical fidelity or exhaustive per-pixel alpha certification is inferred from these browser screenshots.

limitations: Local Vite development runtime; this is not a production deployment or packaged-build browser verification.
Mobile coverage is Chromium touch emulation at 390×844 and deviceScaleFactor 1, not physical phones or cross-browser testing.
The three new costumes keep one static illustration during sampled movement and attacks; no new frame cycles or animation coverage are implied.
Scenery anchoring and shared parallax were checked at the observed initial and post-movement positions; this is not exhaustive camera-boundary or long-session testing.
Coverage is the eleven V10 assets and described training/gallery flows; full historical game modes, balance and performance were not revalidated.
Browser rendering checks do not certify exact canonical fidelity; historical and imagined incarnations retain their displayed provenance.
Official source links were checked as rendered link text, exact qualified href values and new-tab attributes. External destination pages were not reopened in this local browser check.
Mobile costume option labels are truncated in closed native selects, with explicit adjacent descriptions; tall mobile arena framing includes a solid-color band above the contain-sized background.

scope.method: Chaque PNG listé a été affiché directement via view_image puis examiné visuellement ; aucune conclusion n’est fondée sur une vignette non affichée.

nonBlockingFindings: Les trois selects de tenue coupent leur libellé long dans le champ fermé ; le descriptif visible à côté précise la tenue.
La capture mobile de la fiche Crymini ne couvre pas le bas du texte, situé hors du viewport.
summary.result: Les dix captures mobiles demandées passent la revue de lisibilité, de cadrage des silhouettes et de composition visibles.

limits: Revue des pixels des captures fournies, pas une nouvelle session interactive ni un test sur appareil physique.
Les interactions, erreurs réseau et débordements DOM relèvent du rapport browser-qa-run.json ; ils n’ont pas été réexécutés par ce relecteur.
Les captures de scène figées ne suffisent pas à attester le comportement en mouvement, les techniques de combat ou l’absence d’animation de personnages.
Aucune fidélité absolue 1:1, exhaustivité canonique ou validation d’assets hors des dix SHA listés n’est revendiquée.
Les captures recadrées sur un composant ne démontrent pas à elles seules l’ensemble de la page ni tous les autres viewports.
